shared_elements: vertical flat-faced panel or slab worked from stone
loose rubble and debris at the base
open sky at top of frame
justification: The only real correspondence is material and format: both show a pale, weathered stone surface worked into flat vertical faces, photographed from below with rubble at the base and sky above. A shows no discernible imagery at all — only smoothed panels and natural fracturing — whereas B is densely covered with carved relief animals, birds and a banded pattern, so there is no shared iconography or manner of rendering.
